The site is Terraform Ceramics Co-op — Kiln Firing Shelf Booking, a booking web application for Pottery studio shared kiln firings schedule.

Owner brief: "Our community ceramics collective shares two large electric kilns and needs an online firing schedule. Ceramicists should view available bisque and glaze firing cycles, reserve shelf space by height and shelf count, and provide their studio member ID. Reservations must persist on the server so refreshing the schedule shows reserved space as occupied."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-03/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Terraform Ceramics Co-op — Kiln Firing Shelf Booking: the page for pottery studio shared kiln firings schedule, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #c2410c (tc-clay), #fef3c7 (tc-sand), #78350f (tc-earth), #292524 (tc-slate), #fafaf9 (tc-bg), #e7e5e4 (tc-border), #ffffff (tc-surface). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--tc-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a calendar widget that hides the available slots behind extra clicks; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Terraform Ceramics Co-op — Kiln Firing Shelf Booking as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Studio member ID", "Kiln", "Firing cycle", "Firing cone temperature", "Shelf count", "Shelf height (inches)", "Firing date", "Firing notes").

User journey context: Inspect scheduled kiln firing dates and available shelf space. Fill out the shelf reservation form with member ID, firing type, and shelf dimensions. Submit the reservation, inspect the confirmation reference, and verify the slot appears on the firing schedule.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
